_comment: TASK-SCOPE PARITY CORPUS — 'the corpus is the contract'.
Consumed by BOTH: vitest __tests__/decision/task-scope.test.ts
(lib/decision/task-scope.ts) and ruke-server/src/task_scope.rs
(#[cfg(test)] include_str!). Expected values are exact-match: field
order, target order (span start ascending), and vocabulary.
Vocabulary law: derivation is deterministic — explicit URLs/domains
via the PSL detector, or bare names bound by operational/source
prepositions in the user's own words, or bound as the direct object of
a site-taking verb (open/search/use/visit/…). NEVER a domain guess: no
brand tables, no TLD invention, no PascalCase brand heuristics.
Identity law (2026-11-03 audit #5): candidate resolution is normalized-
label EQUALITY only. Prefix/resemblance (zeptodiscounts.com for Zepto)
NEVER resolves — PSL validity is not ownership evidence.
Fixtures are ASCII-only (char-offset parity); non-ASCII targets are
a documented limitation.
§4c continuation law (2026-11-13 brief): bare connectives and
temporals ('now', 'and', 'but', 'then') are NOT continuation evidence;
genuine anaphora (pronouns/demonstratives/'same'/'again') plus the
additive adverbs 'too'/'also' are — and they prove continuation ONLY
when a previous scope exists to resolve the antecedent against. A
short question or a bare 'now' asks on its own and RESETS the scope.
Documented flip: 'followup-inherits-previous-scope' ('now find the
price') was the legacy brittle-cue pin; it is renamed and its
expectation inverted by design, with the surviving continuity legs
('its', 'same', 'and what about…', 'add bread too') kept as positive
controls.
F04 self-task law (2026-11-15): a turn whose leading slot holds a CONTENT
token (a word outside every closed-class vocabulary in this law) AND that
names further lexical matter carries its OWN task. An anaphora cue inside
such a turn ('Write a poem about it') is language-level reference only -
it does NOT inherit the previous ACTION or destination, because a pronoun
is not a permission. Elliptical fragments and turns built from this
domain's own vocabulary ('add bread too', 'the chargers again', 'on the
checkout page') keep carrying the session.
Enums: intent = none|research|site_info|operate|compare_sites;
state = unresolved|resolved|ambiguous;
provenance = none|explicit_url|explicit_domain|resolved_search|resolved_cache|ambiguous.

cases._why: audit WS01 (2026-11-05): a locative 'in <NP>' POST-MODIFYING a content entity NP (jobs/scholarships/apartments) is a GEOGRAPHIC RESTRICTION, never a site destination; adjectival 'open' (inside a find-verb's object phrase) must never make the intent operational.

cases.prompt: Find open backend engineering jobs in Hyderabad.

cases.name: adjectival-open-makes-no-site

cases._why: positive controls: the locative rule must NOT widen. 'in' after an anaphoric pronoun object still licenses the platform ('do this in Blinkit' pattern); an explicit job-site domain keeps source affinity WITHOUT browser routing.
cases.name: locative-rule-keeps-pronoun-platform-in
cases.prompt: do this in reddit.com

cases.name: locative-rule-keeps-explicit-job-site

cases._why: §4c (2026-11-13): a bare temporal head ('now') on its own ask is not continuation evidence and derives no site — the merge table decides what it does to a PREVIOUS scope; standalone it must be scope-free.
cases.name: temporal-now-no-scope-ask
cases.prompt: now find the price

cases._why: §4c positive control: 'add bread too' has no site of its own (no preposition, no site-taking verb; 'bread' stays unbound as in 'buy milk on blinkit' where 'milk' never binds), so it derives NO intent — session continuity comes from the merge fold on the additive cue 'too', never from this turn inventing a destination.
cases.name: elliptical-add-no-site
cases.prompt: add bread too

merges._why: §4c INVERTED LEGACY PIN (documented fixture change, 2026-11-13): this was 'followup-inherits-previous-scope' — 'now' as a bare temporal once proved continuation of the wrong subject. 'now' is not anaphora; a fresh ask with its own verb resets the scope. The name records the new expectation.
merges.name: bare-now-ask-resets-scope
target-change-replaces-scope

merges._why: §4c positive control: a leading connective is stripped BEFORE the fragment test ('and what about…' is an interrogative-headed fragment with no verb of its own), so the elliptical question still resolves its antecedent against the previous scope — the connective itself is not what carries it.
merges.name: connective-headed-fragment-carries
merges.prompt: and what about the delivery fee

merges._why: §4c counterexample to the control above: the SAME leading connective before an imperative verb ask ('and find the price') is a complete fresh ask, not a fragment — it resets. One connective removal must not turn every following ask into a continuation.
merges.name: connective-headed-ask-resets

merges._why: F04 (2026-11-15): the milk-order destination and the operate action must not survive a turn that states its own action (write) and its own matter (poem); the cue 'it' is language-level reference.
merges.name: new-action-with-oblique-pronoun-resets

merges._why: F04 second leg, different wording: the demonstrative 'this' is likewise not a permission (content verb 'translate' + own matter 'French').
merges.name: new-action-demonstrative-resets

merges._why: positive control for the self-task law: an elliptical fragment built only of closed-class vocabulary continues an ongoing site session, which is what browser operate turns rely on.
merges.name: ui-fragment-in-ongoing-session-carries
